title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (inferred from this page, the previous page and the next page; the identification of the groups is an interpretation). X is a hyperbolic curve of type (g,ν) over Q̄, and x is a point of X. The next page speaks of M_{g,ν} ⊂ Autext(π̂_{g,ν}) and of torsors under M'_{g,ν}, which points to this reading:
- π_{X,x} = π̂_1(X_{Q̄}, x), the geometric fundamental group of the curve.
- 𝔊_{X,x} = geometric π̂_1 of the moduli stack M_{g,ν+1}, based at the point (X,x). It contains π_{X,x} as the fibre group of the forgetful map M_{g,ν+1} → M_{g,ν}.
- 𝒞_{X,x} = 𝔊_{X,x}/π_{X,x}, the geometric π̂_1 of M_{g,ν} at X (profinite Teichmüller modular group).
- M_{X,x} = arithmetic π_1 of M_{g,ν+1} over Q. It sits in an extension 1 → 𝔊 → M → Γ_{Q̄/Q} → 1.
- N_{X,x} = M_{X,x}/π_{X,x} = arithmetic π_1 of M_{g,ν} over Q, an extension 1 → 𝒞 → N → Γ_Q → 1.
- M_{X,x,K} and N_{X,x,K} are the pullbacks to an open subgroup Γ_{K̄/K} (formulas (12), (13), (13') on the previous page).

Step 1 (end of previous page and top of this page). Suppose (X,x) is defined over a number field K, i.e. we have a K-model. This gives a K-rational point of the moduli stack, hence a section of M_{X,x,K} → Γ_K. Because the square is cartesian, such a section is the same as a lift Γ_{K̄/K} → M_{X,x} over the inclusion Γ_K ⊂ Γ_Q (diagram (14), dashed arrow). Likewise, a K-model of X alone gives a lift Γ_K → N_{X,x} (diagram (14')).

Step 2 (boxed with a triple marginal bar). Conjecture: 'I think these data allow one to reconstitute (K, K̄, (X,x)), resp. (K, K̄, X).'
- K is recovered trivially as the fixed field of the open subgroup.
- The real content is anabelian: the K-form of the curve (and of the point) is determined by the lifted homomorphism.
- Read with surjectivity, the claim is that every such lift comes from a K-model. That is a section conjecture for the moduli stacks M_{g,ν+1} and M_{g,ν}.

Step 3. Simplification. A lift (14) makes Γ_K act by conjugation on the normal subgroup π_{X,x} ⊂ M_{X,x}. This gives a genuine action Γ_K → Aut(π_{X,x}) (15), which is the Galois action on π_1(X_{K̄}, x) at the rational base point. A lift (14') gives only an outer action Γ_K → Autext(π_{X,x}) (15'), since π is not a subgroup of N.

Step 4 (next page). The aim is to show that these representations, together with a Γ-stable choice of discrete structures (discretizations of π̂_{g,ν}), essentially recover everything. The set of such discretizations is a torsor under M'_{g,ν} ⊂ Autext(π̂_{g,ν}).

Purpose: an anabelian description of curves and pointed curves over number fields through the Galois action on the moduli/Teichmüller tower. This is the core of the 'Teichmüllerian' programme behind the Esquisse.
errors: No mathematical error on this page.

The reconstruction claim is stated only as a belief ('Je pense que'). Its injectivity half (the curve over K is determined by the outer Galois representation) was later proved for hyperbolic curves over number fields by Tamagawa (affine case) and Mochizuki (1990s). Its existence half (every lift comes from a K-model, i.e. a section conjecture for M_{g,ν}) remains open.

The previous-page transcription of (13') writes π_{X,x} as the kernel in the top row; by the quotient construction it should be 𝔊_{X,x}/π_{X,x} = 𝒞_{X,x}. This is an inconsistency in the transcription or notes, not on this page.

ideas.what: A K-model of a (pointed) curve over Q̄ corresponds to a lift of Γ_K ⊂ Γ_Q into the arithmetic fundamental group of the moduli stack M_{g,ν+1} (resp. M_{g,ν}), based at the given curve; equivalently, a section of the pulled-back extension.
ideas.modern_name: Rational points of moduli stacks give sections of their arithmetic fundamental groups (Galois sections attached to points of stacks)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (letter to Faltings 1983, Esquisse 1984); later Ihara, Nakamura, Matsumoto
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984), §2 on the Teichmüller tower and anabelian M_{g,ν}; letter to Faltings (27 June 1983)

ideas.what: Conjecture that the lift reconstitutes (K, K̄, (X,x)) resp. (K, K̄, X): an anabelian / section conjecture for the moduli stacks M_{g,ν+1} and M_{g,ν}.
ideas.modern_name: Anabelian conjecture / section conjecture for moduli stacks of curves; Isom conjecture for curves
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck 1983 (letter to Faltings); Isom part proved by Nakamura, Tamagawa and Mochizuki (1990s)
ideas.where_published: Letter to Faltings (1983) and Esquisse d'un programme list M_{g,ν} among anabelian objects; this page is an earlier (1981–82) formulation

ideas.what: Passage from a lift to the Galois action on π_1: genuine action Γ_K → Aut(π_{X,x}) for a rational base point, outer action Γ_K → Autext(π_X) for the unpointed curve.
ideas.modern_name: Galois representation on the geometric fundamental group; outer Galois representation
ideas.where_published: SGA1 Exp. IX–XIII (homotopy exact sequence); Esquisse

missed.claim: Dated early formulation (1981–82, before the 1983 Faltings letter) of the anabelian reconstruction conjecture phrased for the moduli stacks themselves, i.e. via lifts into π_1 of M_{g,ν+1} and M_{g,ν}, rather than for an individual curve.
missed.quote: Je pense que ces données permettent de reconstituer (K,K̄,(X,x)) resp. (K,K̄,X)
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Historical: it shows the moduli-stack (section-conjecture-for-M_{g,ν}) version was in place in the Teichmüller notes, earlier than its usual dating. The existence half is still open. No new mathematics beyond what is known.

deep.surprise_reason: The ideas match what later appeared in the Faltings letter and the Esquisse; the main interest is an earlier dating and the explicit moduli-stack phrasing of the section/anabelian conjecture. Nothing here is absent from the literature in substance.
transcription_corrections: Line 1 likely reads 'De [barré] façon que un relèvement…' (or 'De même que…'). It continues the sentence from the previous page: 's'exprime par une section … de façon équivalente par un relèvement'.
In (14) the base is written Γ_{Q̃/Q}, with a tilde, as on the previous page, rather than Γ_{Q̄/Q}. The diagonal arrow Γ_{K̄/K} → M_{X,x} is dashed (the lift).
The line read as 'le dessin pointé }' is very uncertain; it probably refers to the datum of x resp. of the K-structure ('la donnée … resp. …}'), not a 'dessin'.
'restriction du corps de définition de X à K' – the reading 'corps de définition' seems plausible.
The subscripts in (15)/(15') are unclear. Most likely (15) is Aut(π_{X,x}) (perhaps with a small subscript) and (15') is Autext(π_{X,x}), i.e. outer automorphisms (Grothendieck's notation).
The struck-through line reads approximately 'Ces données donc, puisque'. The conjecture line is marked in the margin by a triple vertical bar.
